sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 x Sets of Keys, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Radios.
Completed debrief and handover with the night shift; prepared equipment and personnel to commence patrols.
Commenced foot patrols along Queen Street, conducting welfare checks on surrounding businesses.
Welfare checks at Localito, Starbucks, McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store; all businesses clear with no issues reported. Continued patrols along Queen Street.
Welfare check at Q Convenience Store; all clear with no concerns reported. Continued patrols.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart; all clear, no issues reported. Remained on standby while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed Britomart and continued patrols towards Gore Street.
Arrived at Gore Street; welfare checks at Customs Mart, 77 Convenience Store on Customs Street and Coffee Club, all clear. Continued patrols through Gore Street.
Welfare check at Auckland Harbour Suites; all clear, no issues reported. Continued patrols towards Fort Street.

Welfare checks at Tribe Hotel, Wilson Carpark on Fort Street, White Lady, 77 Convenience Store, Jo & Joe and The Right Track; all locations clear. Remained on standby while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed the area and continued patrols along High Street towards Chancery Square.
Arrived at Chancery Square; completed security sweeps of Freyberg Place and Chancery Square, both clear with no issues reported. Continued patrols along High Street.

Arrived outside Noel Leeming after hearing an alarm sounding from the premises. On observation, it appeared a staff member attempting to access the building had accidentally triggered the alarm. Security remained on standby while maintaining a visible presence.
Departed the area and continued towards Metropolis to check on the assigned security guard.

While travelling towards Metropolis, observed a dead rat lying on the public footpath; identified it as a potential public health and safety concern and obtained cardboard to safely remove it from the pedestrian area.
Successfully removed the dead rat from the footpath and disposed of it in a rubbish bin; the obstruction was cleared, reducing the risk of public contact.

Arrived at the corner of Victoria Street; welfare checks at News Agency, Coffee Club, V-Phix, 77 Convenience Store, Eighty Fed and Amelia Cafe, all clear. Remained on standby while maintaining security presence.
Departed Victoria Street and continued patrols along Federal Street towards Wyndham Street.
Arrived at St Patrick's Square and completed a full security sweep of the area; all clear, no issues reported. Remained on standby while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed St Patrick's Square and continued patrols along Albert Street towards Commercial Bay.
Welfare check at Albert Mart; all clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at Lower Albert Street and commenced security sweeps and welfare checks on surrounding businesses.
Welfare checks at Woolworths and TK Square; both locations clear with no concerns reported. Remained on standby while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed the area to conduct a welfare check at McDonald's before continuing patrols along Queen Street.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart; all clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at Vulcan Lane; welfare checks on businesses along Queen Street between Swarovski and New Balance. Continued patrols through Vulcan Lane.
Completed a security sweep and welfare checks along Vulcan Lane; remained on standby while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed Vulcan Lane and continued patrols towards Chemist Warehouse, conducting welfare checks on businesses along the route.
Arrived near Chemist Warehouse; welfare checks at Macpac, Kathmandu, JB Hi-Fi, Hallensteins, Mountain Warehouse and OPSM, all clear. Proceeded to check in with Chemist Warehouse staff.

Welfare check at Chemist Warehouse; spoke with the assigned security guard and store manager, who both reported operations running well. Staff advised that newly installed facial-recognition cameras had helped reduce shoplifting by flagging individuals already identified in their system when entering the store. No current concerns reported. Remained on standby while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed Chemist Warehouse and continued patrols along Wyndham Street.

Arrived at the intersection of Wyndham Street and Albert Street; welfare checks at QFTav, Coffee Club, Japan Mart, Koffee Bar and Hollywood Bakery, all clear. Remained on standby while maintaining security presence.
Departed the area and continued patrols towards Durham Street.

Arrived at the intersection of Durham Street and Queen Street; security sweeps and welfare checks at the Wilson Carparks, Midtown Mini Supermarket, BBQ King Restaurant, Dunkin' Donuts and 2degrees, all clear. Remained on standby while maintaining a visible security presence.
Continued welfare checks on surrounding businesses.

Welfare checks on businesses from Merii & Gifts through to Specsavers, and from Mirrou through to Lovisa; all businesses clear with no concerns reported. Continued patrols towards the intersection of Victoria Street and Queen Street.
Welfare checks on businesses from Glassons and Lush through to Farmers and Mecca; all locations clear with no issues reported.
Welfare checks at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse on Victoria Street; both businesses clear. Remained on standby while maintaining security presence.
Departed Victoria Street and continued patrols towards Elliott Street and Darby Street.

Completed patrol of Elliott Street; the area was generally clear with no immediate disturbances. While maintaining a presence outside Lumi Cafe, staff raised further complaints regarding an ongoing unpleasant odour near the premises — a restricted-access area containing a fire hose has repeatedly been used as a place for public urination by homeless individuals. Security documented the concern and continued monitoring the area.

While patrolling near Aotea Square, heard shouting and was approached by members of the public reporting that a person of interest was yelling at and attempting to intimidate pedestrians. Security proceeded towards the reported individual, who ran away towards Hobson Street before contact could be made. Remained on standby near the intersection of Wellesley Street and Federal Street while monitoring the surrounding area.
Departed the area and continued patrols towards Victoria Street.

Arrived at the intersection of Victoria Street and Federal Street; no further sighting of the previously reported POI. Maintained a visible security presence and remained alert for the individual in case further surveillance was required.
Received a response call from Q Convenience Store regarding three young males gathered outside the premises; security immediately proceeded to the location to assist the shopkeeper.
Arrived at Q Convenience Store and spoke with the staff member to establish the circumstances of the complaint.

Staff reported that three juveniles had entered the store requesting food and drinks and, when refused, allegedly attempted to steal merchandise. Security approached the juveniles and instructed them to move along to ensure the shopkeeper felt safe and to prevent further disturbances. Remained on standby outside the premises.
Departed Q Convenience Store and returned towards HQ for a scheduled break.
Arrived at HQ and commenced break.
Remained on standby at HQ awaiting the incoming shift for handover.
Remained at HQ charging the Ops Phone, as the battery was at 5%, while awaiting shift changeover.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received (deployed 14:35): 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radios, 2 x Body Cameras, 1 x Swipe Key.
Remained on standby at HQ while charging the Ops Phone until sufficient battery charge was available for patrols.
Ops Phone reached sufficient battery charge; remained on standby awaiting the arrival of security guards.
Completed debrief with the morning shift; prepared equipment and commenced patrols.
Completed a full security sweep of Darby Street; welfare checks at Lumi Cafe, Recycle Boutique, Pizza Club, Mali Thai and Celine's Eatery. Continued patrols towards Elliott Street.
Received a call from management requesting assistance with providing building access to relatives who required entry to Level 7; returned towards HQ to assist.
Arrived at the location and provided swipe-card access to Level 7 for the visitors; returned to HQ to prepare equipment before resuming patrols.

Completed a full security sweep of Queen Street, conducting welfare checks on businesses from Mecca and Farmers through to ANZ and Van Cleef & Arpels; all locations clear. Continued towards Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart and commenced a full security sweep of the surrounding area.

Completed a full security sweep of Britomart, including welfare checks around the Downtown Waterfront, Commercial Bay Shopping Centre and McDonald's Britomart; all locations clear with no concerns reported.

Encountered a female vagrant outside Pandora on Queen Street playing loud music with inappropriate content in a public area. Security approached the individual calmly and requested she lower the volume; she responded aggressively and directed verbal insults towards security personnel. Security maintained a visible presence in the area while monitoring the situation.
Received a response call from Mountain Warehouse regarding a male individual inside the premises suspected of shoplifting; security immediately proceeded to the location.

Arrived at Mountain Warehouse and spoke with staff, who advised the suspected individual was currently inside a changing room. Security remained on standby near the entrance to monitor the situation and respond if theft was observed.

Conducted a follow-up welfare check at Mountain Warehouse; staff confirmed the individual had left the premises without any merchandise in his possession. No theft confirmed and no further issues reported. Resumed patrols towards Wyndham Street.

Received a response call from Woolworths on Victoria Street regarding a group of vagrants reportedly shouting, swearing and fighting near the premises; security immediately diverted from routine patrols and proceeded to the location.

Arrived at Woolworths Victoria Street and observed a group of individuals shouting and directing verbal abuse towards a member of the public; no physical altercation was occurring on arrival. Security intervened to prevent the situation from escalating and remained on standby while attempting to resolve the disturbance.

Despite repeated attempts to calm the situation, tensions continued between the parties. The affected member of the public expressed emotional distress and requested that Police be contacted immediately; security contacted Police and provided details of the incident.

Police advised that officers were unable to attend as the incident was assessed as non-urgent, and requested the affected member of the public's details. Security stood down from the incident and resumed patrols towards Elliott Street.

Completed a full security sweep of Elliott Street; welfare checks at Coco Lane, Elliott Food Court and Elliott Atrium, all clear. Arrived at Elliott Stables and maintained a visible security presence (17:38–18:07).
Completed a full security sweep of Elliott Stables; all clear, no issues reported. Continued patrols towards Aotea Square via Metro Centre.
Arrived at Aotea Square and commenced a full security sweep of the area, continuing patrols, surveillance and a visible security presence throughout (18:09–19:30).
Completed a full security sweep of Aotea Square; continued patrols towards Lorne Street.
Welfare check along Rutland Street; all clear, no issues reported.
Completed a security sweep of the upper section of Lorne Street; all clear with no concerns observed. Continued patrols towards Lower Lorne Street.
Welfare check around the Lorne Street staircase mural; all clear, no issues reported. Continued patrols.
Completed a full security sweep of Lorne Street; all clear with no concerns observed. Continued patrols towards High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and commenced a full security sweep of the area.

Completed a full security sweep of Freyberg Place and Chancery Square; welfare checks along O'Connell Street, Chancery Street and businesses within the surrounding area. Continued patrols along High Street.
Welfare checks throughout Vulcan Lane and surrounding businesses; all clear, no issues reported.
Completed a full security sweep of High Street; all clear with no concerns observed. Continued patrols towards Queen Street.
Welfare checks along Shortland Street, including Shortland Mart and Taco Bell; all businesses clear with no concerns reported.
Completed a full security sweep of Queen Street; no issues identified or reported. Continued patrols towards Elliott Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Elliott Street; welfare check, all clear:
Arrived at Elliott Stables and maintained security presence while standing by for potential disturbances.

Received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding two vagrants causing concern at the premises — one individual outside the restaurant and a second sleeping inside. Security immediately proceeded to the location.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street and approached both individuals; politely instructed them to leave the restaurant and surrounding premises. Both complied and moved along without incident. Security remained outside the restaurant to maintain a visible presence and prevent further disturbances.
Conducted a follow-up welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street; all clear with no further concerns reported. Departed towards HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at HQ and commenced charging the Ops Phone due to low battery.
Remained on standby at HQ awaiting the incoming night shift for handover.
Afternoon shift concluded; handover to the night shift completed successfully.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received (deployed 22:31): 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Radios.
Remained on standby at HQ awaiting the arrival of the second security guard.
Second security guard arrived on-site; commenced patrols.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart; all clear, no issues reported.
Completed a full security sweep of Darby Street; all clear with no concerns observed.
Completed a full security sweep of Elliott Street; no issues reported.
Arrived at Aotea Square and commenced a full security sweep of the area (22:58–23:28).
Completed a full security sweep of Aotea Square; all clear, no issues reported. Continued patrols towards Lorne Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Lorne Street; all clear with no concerns observed.
Completed patrols along High Street and Vulcan Lane; both areas clear with no issues reported.
Completed a full security sweep of Fort Lane; all clear, no issues observed.
Completed a full security sweep of Fort Street; all clear with no concerns reported.
Completed a full security sweep of Customs Street East; no issues reported.
Arrived at Commercial Bay and commenced a full security sweep of the surrounding area (00:20–00:45).

Completed a full security sweep of Commercial Bay; welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Maintained a visible security presence due to increased activity involving homeless individuals in the area.
Departed Commercial Bay and continued patrols towards Victoria Street via Albert Street.
Arrived at the intersection of Wyndham Street and Albert Street; completed security checks of the surrounding area, all clear.
Arrived at the intersection of Victoria Street and Albert Street; welfare check at Albert Mart, all clear. Continued patrols towards Aotea Square.
Completed a full security sweep of Mayoral Drive; no issues reported.
Arrived at Aotea Square and commenced another full security sweep of the area.
Completed a full security sweep of Aotea Square; all clear, no issues reported.

While patrolling near Aotea Square, heard individuals shouting around the corner outside the Civic Theatre. Approached the individuals and politely requested they lower their voices to avoid disturbing the surrounding area; both complied with security instructions and departed in separate directions. No further issues occurred. Security remained on standby while maintaining a visible presence.
Departed Aotea Square and returned towards HQ to conduct scheduled floor checks.
Arrived at HQ and commenced floor checks.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street; no issues reported by staff. Maintained a visible security presence due to increased activity involving homeless individuals in the surrounding area.
Completed a full security sweep of Darby Street; all clear, no issues reported.
Completed a full security sweep of Elliott Street; all clear with no concerns observed.
Completed a full security sweep of Wellesley Street; no issues reported.
Arrived at Aotea Square and commenced a full security sweep of the area.
Completed a full security sweep of Aotea Square; all clear, no issues reported. Remained on standby while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed Aotea Square and continued patrols towards Commercial Bay via Queen Street.
Arrived at Commercial Bay and commenced a full security sweep of the area.
Completed a full security sweep of Commercial Bay; all clear, no issues reported. Remained on standby while maintaining security presence (04:40–05:10).
Concluded standby at Commercial Bay; no incidents occurred and no response calls received. Continued patrols along Queen Street.
Completed patrol of Fort Street; all clear with no concerns reported.
Completed patrol of Vulcan Lane; all clear with no issues observed.
Completed a full security sweep of Durham Street West; all clear, no issues reported.
Completed a full security sweep of Durham Street East; all clear with no concerns observed.
Conducted security checks around the Victoria Street West intersection; all clear, no issues reported.
Completed security sweeps of Elliott Street, Elliott Atrium and Darby Street; all locations clear with no concerns reported.
Conducted a final welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street; staff reported no issues requiring security assistance. Departed towards HQ for a break and to await the incoming morning shift.
Night shift concluded; handover to the morning shift completed successfully.

flags: SENSITIVE: 17:07–17:32 Woolworths Victoria Street disturbance — group directing verbal abuse at a member of the public; Police contacted at the affected person's request but advised they were unable to attend (assessed non-urgent). Affected member of the public was emotionally distressed.
SENSITIVE: 16:40 verbal insults directed at security personnel by a female vagrant outside Pandora after a volume request.
QA: morning section has no formal shift-end entry — last logged entry 14:15 (charging Ops Phone awaiting changeover); afternoon deployed 14:35.
